## Topics
- Adding predictors and adjusting for confounders
- Crude vs. adjusted estimates side by side
- Categorical predictors and interaction terms
- Comparing models (adjusted R-squared, AIC)
- Checking model assumptions

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Fit and interpret a multiple regression
- Present crude and adjusted estimates in one table
- Interpret a categorical predictor and an interaction
- Compare candidate models and justify a choice

## Data
NHANES: systolic BP ~ age + BMI + sex + smoking
